channel.title: Wire — Cloud
channel.description: Cloud from thirty sources, one digest a day.

item.title: Amazon Aurora DSQL now supports foreign key constraints
item.description: Amazon Aurora DSQL now lets you add foreign key constraints to new and existing tables. Aurora DSQL is a serverless, distributed SQL database with PostgreSQL compatibility and active-active multi-Region availability. (1 source: aws)

item.title: AWS Backup adds cross-Region and cross-account backup support for Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP
item.description: AWS Backup now supports copying Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP backups across AWS Regions and accounts. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Mountpoint for Amazon S3 adds memory usage controls
item.description: Mountpoint for Amazon S3 can now limit memory usage, either automatically based on the environment it runs in or with a limit that you define. (1 source: aws)

item.title: AWS Open Sources Kiro Crew for Asynchronous Coding Agents
item.description: Amazon recently announced Kiro Crew, an open-source system for running multiple Kiro coding agents across sessions, tools, and tasks. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: Amazon EVS now supports i7i.metal-48xl Amazon EC2 instance type
item.description: Today, we're announcing that Amazon Elastic VMware Service (Amazon EVS) now supports the i7i.metal-48xl Amazon Elastic Cloud Compute (Amazon EC2) bare-metal instance type, offering a higher core-count option with a newer generation… (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon Cognito adds admin API operation to reset user TOTP configurations
item.description: Amazon Cognito now provides a new admin API operation to reset a user's time-based one-time Password (TOTP) multi-factor authentication (MFA) configuration. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon Connect Customer now supports unplanned shrinkage in agent schedules
item.description: Amazon Connect Customer now enables managers to input unplanned shrinkage in agent schedules, providing a more accurate picture of staffing due to unscheduled agent absences such as late logins or unplanned sick leave. (1 source: aws)
